sloka: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने ।मधु मूल फलैः जीवन् हित्वा मुनिवद् आमिषम् ॥२-२०-२९॥
transliteration: caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane ।madhu mūla phalaiḥ jīvan hitvā munivad āmiṣam ॥2-20-29॥

translations.english: Abstaining from eating meat like hermits and living on honey, fruits and roots, I am to live in the solitary forest for fourteen years.
